_anchor: cricbuzz_id -> cricinfo_id, derived from unique performance fingerprints (Layer A) and the dismissal join (Layer B). NEVER from names.
_tiers: tier = number of DISTINCT MATCHES confirming the pair. >=1 cross-check only; >=2 required before a CB-only field may CREATE points.
_note: each pair's `confirmations` list IS the fact log; bridge/revoked are a pure function of it (compile_bridge o confirmations_log). Regenerate, never hand-edit. A contradicted pair moves to `revoked` and is refused BOTH ways — there is no last-wins.
